title: Research: certify the complete PR2979 data boundary
body:
## Summary

Check the complete normalized data map of both original PR2979 emitted programs in both orientations, under the stated native/scalar contracts.

```diff
 source-bound PR2979 native/helper audit
+ every one of the 224 source/target outputs
+ separate original-source covectors for every emitted output
+ data fault invisible to every helper/private observation
```

The map is `X'=X, Y'=Y+X` forward and `X'=X-Y, Y'=Y` for inverse transpose. The original source-word auditor already checks its map. This package adds explicit complete emitted-data coverage using credited existing covector implementations. Native realization is an explicit prior PR3442 premise. No new supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3442 explicitly left source/target application outside its complete native/helper coverage.
  **After:** 896 exact output equations pass across both providers and orientations, each covering a complete 22,748-event stream and comparing separate emitted/source pullbacks.
- At event 22,464, an inserted same-FULL-chart `L0 += L1` corrupts data while all 408 helper outputs and all 91 private-free values remain correct. All four cases reject the data fault. Source binding also rejects the insertion; this is a distinction between observations, not a reported defect in the original word.
- Seven normal/optimized behavior groups, final registered fresh replays, Ruff, source pins, committed bytes/source history and the actual committed Git-free export checks pass. Full exact receipts, source pins, proof, reproduction and limits are in `research/rank7-data-shear-boundary`.

Canonical base is `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6; original PR2979 is `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576`. [Canonical scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19009648).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only an isolated research package is added. Physical rational scalar/COPY/CLEAR, known-zero allocation, native realization and coordinate contracts remain premises. Actual T74 ownership, storage/movement, precision/tape, the full supplier invoice and outer/uniform obligations remain separate. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
